composed_rule: value = [object+0x18]; if value == 0, return without reading [object+0x10]
node = [object+0x10]; fn = node vtable slot +0x38; if fn differs from the runtime guard value (GOT 0x5777960, RELATIVE to 0x4f9ea60), call fn(node, value, 0) and return
otherwise step node = [node+0x38] and compare each next node's slot +0x38 against the previous node's slot; the first differing dispose is tail-called with (node, value, 0)

if the first five nodes all carry the guard dispose, the fifth node's dispose is tail-called unconditionally; when that dispose is the guard, it continues the same walk from [node+0x38] over nine nodes, so the walk is unbounded
the guard passes its second argument through untouched and its flag as the zero-extended dl byte; dispose always passes flag 0

call_site.note: the only call in the function; after it returns, rsp is restored and dispose returns. All other invocations are tail jumps.

null_arm.rule: value at [object+0x18] == 0 returns immediately; the head node at [object+0x10] is never read on this path

dispose.window_rule: examine five nodes starting at [object+0x10]; the first node's dispose is compared against the runtime guard value; later nodes against the previous node's dispose; the first differing dispose is invoked with (node, value, 0) -- a call for the first node, a tail jump for later nodes -- and the fifth node's dispose is tail-called unconditionally

got.file_bytes_note: GOT slots are loader-filled; the file bytes are zero and are NOT the guard value. The runtime value is the RELATIVE relocation addend.

arguments.rdi: node whose guard dispose was invoked
arguments.rdx: flag byte in dl, zero-extended by movzbl, passed through unchanged
arguments.rsi: second dispose argument, untouched by the guard

guard.window_rule: walk from [node+0x38] onward; the first node's dispose is compared against the guard itself (the GOT value, which is this function's own address); later nodes against the previous node's dispose; the first differing dispose is tail-called with (node, value, flag); the ninth node's dispose is tail-called unconditionally, so a guard tail-call recurses and the walk is unbounded

landing_pad_note: the bytes at 0x514bb95 are a separate FDE (0x00633d7c, pc 0x514bb95..0x514bba5: string _M_dispose + _Unwind_Resume), not part of dispose and not claimed here; dispose itself has zero int3 padding

inferences: the 'guard' reading of GOT 0x5777960 (its addend is the guard's own address, and both functions skip nodes whose slot equals it)
the equivalence of previous-slot compares to guard compares (each is reachable only when the previous slot equalled the guard)
the unbounded-walk reading of the unconditional final tail calls
